title: Chapter 317 Fighting The Bronze Beast
content:
Chapter 317 Fighting The Bronze Beast

The owner of the bronze palace.

Chu Xingyue thought of this in her heart and then slowly walked to the statue.

Suddenly, a majestic voice sounded from the bottom of my heart.

"Pious believers, please worship me with the highest respect!"

boom!

In an instant, Chu Xingyue was shocked and she took a few steps back.

The moment she heard the cry in her heart, her imperial heart was shaken.

"Sister Chu Xingyue, pay homage to senior."

Chu Xingyue, who came to her senses, suddenly became respectful, and then bowed to the bronze statue in front of her.

However, the statue did not respond.

After a long time, Chu Xingyue slowly looked up and looked at the huge statue in front of her. Chu Xingyue's eyebrows were slightly frowned.

After a moment, Chu Xingyue left here.

I don’t know how long it took, but many people appeared in the huge hall again.

There were also many people who came to worship the bronze statues, but the statues were never moved.

Rumble!

Inside a door opening.

Lu Xue and others were moving forward carefully.

Suddenly, the ground began to tremble.

I saw a gate suddenly appeared in front of me.

On both sides of the gate, there are two bronze beast statues.

"Damn, this bronze beast has moved!"

Xiao Luo exclaimed in surprise.

I saw that the two bronze beasts suddenly began to tremble, and then their breath rose. The next moment it attacked Lu Xue and others, with their teeth and claws spreading, and their breath was terrifying.

boom!

In an instant, Lu Xue and others fought with the bronze beast directly.

"Puff~"

With a collision between the bronze beast, Xiao Luo directly spit out a mouthful of blood.

This bronze beast actually has the strength of the middle stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

For a moment, Lu Xue and others were at a disadvantage.

At this moment, Lu Xue's face looked extremely ugly.

She is the Immortal Lord Realm, and she fights either the Immortal Emperor Realm or the Immortal Emperor Realm every day.

Is she easy?

bite!

Qin Feng seized the opportunity and stabbed the bronze beast with a sudden sword.

However, a crisp metal collision sound came, followed by numbness in the arms.

"Damn it, this bronze beast's body is so terrifying!"

On the other side, Lu Xue and Ao Qing fought against another bronze beast. However, even with Ao Qing's help, it could only block the bronze beast for a moment.

If you want to cause damage to the bronze beast, even if Lu Xue uses the Xuanyuan Sword, she can only cut out a trace, which will not hurt or itch to the bronze beast.

"Damn it, is that all that ends?"

Lu Xue's expression was gloomy.

At this moment, she suddenly thought of the fighting she heard when she first entered here.

I guess that guy Chen Mingyu has encountered similar creatures.

"Xiaoqing, use fire."

At this time, Lu Xue suddenly spoke.

Hearing this, although Ao Qing was puzzled, he still spit out a powerful dragon breath.

In an instant, the bronze beast fell into a sea of fire.

"My master, it's useless. This guy is not afraid of fire."

Lu Xue did not speak, but pushed her hands.

Suddenly, the sea of fire dissipated, and replaced by a piece of ice.

Scream—

In the distance, the surface of the bronze beast suddenly began to whistle.

Seeing this scene, Lu Xue said, "Xiaoqing, continue."

At this moment, Ao Qing seemed to understand something.

The next moment, another dragon breath spewed out.

"Extreme Cold Field!"

Buzz —

The temperature began to drop rapidly again.

That's it, I don't know how many times it has been repeated.

Click!

The body of the bronze beast in the distance suddenly began to sound.

Seeing this, Lu Xue no longer hesitated and went straight forward and stabbed him with a sword.

This time, the sound of metal collisions no longer sounded.

The huge bronze beast was directly penetrated by Lu Xue's Xuanyuan Sword.

"Success!"

Lu Xue's face was delighted.

And at this moment, a cry came from the other side.

"Sister Xue, help me!"

I saw that Xiao Luo and the others who could withstand for a while at the beginning were already chased by the bronze beast.

Lu Xue sighed, then took Ao Qing toward another bronze beast.

After a long time, the other bronze beast was pierced by Lu Xue's sword.

The scene returned to calm again.

"Huh, it's finally solved."

Looking at the bronze beast that fell to the ground in front of him, Xiao Luo and Qin Feng wiped their cold sweat and then breathed a sigh of relief.

The strength of the middle stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

The two of them have just entered the Immortal Emperor Realm. Even if their combat power is strong, they are not ordinary early stages of the Immortal Emperor Realm, but they are still not enough to face the middle stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

Fortunately, these two bronze beasts have no intelligence, and they can solve it even if they use their brains a little.

Lu Xue also sighed slightly.

"Fortunately, my brain works very well."

"What my father said is indeed correct, knowledge is power."

......

"Hahaha, OK, OK."

Looking at Lu Xue who had just won before her, Lu Daosheng couldn't help laughing.

The phantom beside him was shocked by Lu Daosheng.

"What are you doing?"

The phantom was a little confused.

As for this reaction?

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng also reacted. He could not reveal his identity with Lu Xue. He then quickly curled up his smile, coughed lightly, and said seriously: "This little girl is indeed a little bit of something, she deserves to be a destiny."

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Phantom nodded slightly.

"Indeed, I could have thought of this kind of solution."

At this time, Lu Daosheng wanted to shout proudly, I'm teaching it!

It's a pity that he can only hold it in.

At the same time, Lu Xue and others successfully entered the sect.

As soon as you see, there are rows of racks arranged to the end, which looks very spectacular.

And on the shelf are all kinds of treasures and magical medicines.

Seeing this scene, Xiao Luo and Qin Feng suddenly had their eyes lit up.

"Get rich!"

Immediately, the two of them rushed up to search.

But the two of them noticed Lu Xue behind them.

"Sister Xue? Why don't you move?"

Lu Xue's expression was extremely speechless at this moment.

"You two go."

"Oh, okay."

Xiao Luo and the others didn't ask much. After all, they still knew what Lu Xue's conditions were.

I guess I don't like this either.

In fact, along the way, I have basically given up all the good things I have encountered to them.

Most of Lu Xue looked down on him.

Unless you encounter a good thing that can directly improve your strength.

Seeing the two plundering, Lu Xue remained indifferent.

“Explanation.”

Lu Xue lifted Ao Qing and shouted coldly.

Upon hearing this, Ao Qing was also a little guilty.

"Little, little master, I really feel that there are treasures here."

"Hmph, I think you're greedy!"

"My little master, do you want to believe me, am I such a dragon?"

"Who are you."

Lu Xue knew Ao Qing’s virtues better.

However, seeing Ao Qing's aggrieved look, Lu Xue also frowned slightly.

After a moment of silence, Lu Xue slowly walked towards the end.

Maybe there are some other treasures here.

Soon, Lu Xue came to an end.

I saw that shelves were still filled with goods, and they were basically filled with precious resources.

But in Lu Xue's eyes, these are of no value at all.

What she wants is treasures that can be used, or inheritance that can directly improve her strength.

At this time, Lu Xue, who was a little disappointed, suddenly noticed that there was a gray door in the distant corner.

Could it be?
